This feels like this isn't going to be easy.
Start up your defenses and prepare for the worst.
They may be faster, but cliff units can easily stop them dead in their tracks.
They may be slow, but don't let your guard down! A horde of these can soak up a lot of damage...
A thick skinned boss is on its way!
We need to get a lot of heavy damage to take down this slow but menacing foe.
Keep an eye out for hidden enemies!
Without the right upgrades, they'll sneak right past your defenses!
They'll turn into a random enemy when killed! I wonder what's inside them?
It can summon enemies from the ground, so kill the necromancer quickly!
Quick and tough enemies are coming in quick!
This enemy has already taken quite a beating, but it can take a lot more!
Look out for the giant boss!
A fast boss that's ALSO hidden?
Please tell me you've got units to detect it by now..
Fast and tanky with Giant bosses in the back.
Get ready for an intense hoard of enemies!
Watch out for his throwing arm, I hear he made the big leagues in baseball... Either way, watch out for the boulders he throws, they stun!
This doesn't look like your normal mystery...
These Mystery bosses will summon OTHER bosses!
These things may be slow, but they make up for that in EXPLOSIVE repercussions!
Boomers will, well, go BOOM when they die, stunning towers!
This boss has extremely high defense and stuns towers with a minigun!
We need a TON of heavy damage to beat him!
